name: Video-ToMe full-propagation engineering gate v1
scope: Full native-schedule propagation on two development sequences for implementation integrity and replay determinism only; not a cohort efficacy study.
selection_note: seq6 and seq8 were selected from prior outcome-informed mechanism diagnostics; this engineering gate is not confirmatory evidence.

method.upstream_operator: tome/merge.py; unmodified bipartite_soft_matching, merge_wavg, and upstream unmerge closure
method.integration: At native SAM2 memory SDPA, match six selected historical maps within each spatial 4x4 tile using projected-key mean-head metric, average matched projected V vectors, then unmerge into the original dense slots.
method.control: Same official matcher and 25% merge budget, applied independently within each past frame.
method.native_weights: Frozen; native Q/K, memory writer, pointers, mask decoder, prompt schedule, and six-map schedule are unchanged.
method.efficiency: No token-count or runtime reduction is claimed; unmerge restores the original number and positions of slots.
method.frame_selection: None; the native six-map schedule is used.

required_checks: Every post-prompt frame is evaluated in chronological order and has finite logits and a saved native reference.
No-op exactly matches the archived native mask, stored memory state, scores, and absent false-positive record on every frame.
All four SAM2 memory-attention layers are audited once per target and arm.
No-op performs zero merges; local uses only within-frame scope and forms zero cross-frame groups.
Cross-frame mode uses local fallback only for a single eligible past map; every multi-map read must form at least one actual cross-frame ToMe group.
Local and cross-frame arms have identical eligible-token counts, dense slots, pointers, key mass, and exact merge budgets (one quarter of eligible tokens).
Memory keys are unchanged during each attention call; SAM2 parameters and native temporal slot table are restored unchanged after each run.
Two fresh processes produce byte-identical deterministic results.json; wall time is stored separately.
stopping_rule: Any integrity failure stops the attempt and writes a failure receipt. Do not alter implementation, targets, merge fraction, or checks in place; amendments require a new protocol version.
next_step: A pass allows freezing a separate 21-sequence efficacy protocol. It is not evidence of a Dice improvement and does not authorize claims of segmentation benefit.

runtime.environment: Existing isolated venv /tmp/adeSeg-tome-gate-venv; no dependency installation during this run.
